question_text: Every instruction passes through four stages: fetch, decode, execute and write-back. Each stage takes exactly one clock cycle and there are no stalls. Calculate the number of clock cycles needed: (i) to complete 10 instructions on one core with no pipelining, where an instruction starts only after the previous one has finished; (ii) to complete 10 instructions on one core with a four-stage pipeline; (iii) to complete 40 independent instructions shared equally between four pipelined cores that run in parallel.
